issues.description: The return type of PersonService.getAllPersons is inconsistent across artifacts: the template declares getAllPersons(...) to return List<Person>, the solution implementation returns Set<Person>, and the solution's PersonResource method (and the problem description) expect a List<Person> to be returned to the REST layer. This mismatch will cause compilation errors and confuses the expected REST response type (the client and problem statement expect a List).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent. Prefer changing PersonService.getAllPersons to return List<Person> (matching the template, the problem statement and the REST endpoint signature) and return a sorted List (for example, return Collections.unmodifiableList(sortedList)). Alternatively, change the REST endpoint and client to accept a Set consistently, but the simpler fix is to have PersonService return List<Person> so the controller and client continue to use List.
